items.title: Google Marketing Live 2026 set for May 20
items.summary: Google Marketing Live 2026 is scheduled for May 20, where the company will unveil updates across advertising, AI, measurement, and campaign automation. This annual event serves as a key announcement day for Google Ads, revealing significant changes like new AI features and tools that impact campaign strategies and optimizations. Marketers should prepare for AI-driven advertising advancements and performance measurement innovations shaping ad strategies for the year.

items.title: Over The Top SEO Launches the Industry's First Full-Scale Generative Engine Optimization Division
items.summary: Over The Top SEO has launched the industry's first full-scale Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) division to ensure brands are cited and accurately represented in AI-generated answers, differing from traditional SEO focused on web rankings. The division is operational with over 450 optimized pages indexed, as AI systems like ChatGPT (60% market share) and Google's AI Overviews dominate queries. This move addresses the need for visibility in AI responses, especially commercial prompts comprising a third of interactions.

items.title: The 4 best answer engine optimization (AEO)/generative engine optimization (GEO) platforms for enterprise companies in 2026
items.summary: The top AEO/GEO platforms for 2026 enterprises are Scrunch, Adobe LLM Optimizer, Bluefish, and Profound, assessed on visibility, security, scale, and integrations. Scrunch and Adobe stand out for delivering AI-optimized content directly to agents, unlike others focused on tracking. Enterprises should trial platforms to match specific AEO/GEO needs like compliance and actionability.

items.title: March 2026 Google Webmaster Report
items.summary: Barry Schwartz's monthly roundup covers key Google SEO and webmaster developments in March 2026. Highlights include new guidance on Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) and other search changes. Essential reading for tracking algorithm shifts and best practices.

items.title: GEO + AEO + Agentic SEO: The Growth Strategy That Wins Every Search
items.summary: 47% of Google searches now feature AI answers first, making GEO, AEO, and Agentic SEO essential for citations. The 90-day strategy guide details how to dominate AI search visibility. Focuses on evolving tactics beyond traditional SEO.

items.title: Thousands of authors publish 'empty' book in protest over AI using their work
items.summary: Thousands of authors, including Kazuo Ishiguro, Philippa Gregory, and Richard Osman, have published an 'empty' book titled 'Don't Steal This Book' to protest against AI firms using their copyrighted works without permission. The initiative was launched at the London Book Fair amid concerns over the UK government's proposed 'commercial research exception' for AI training. It highlights growing tensions between creators and tech companies in the publishing industry.

items.title: 10,000 Authors Protest AI With 'Empty' Book at London Book Fair
items.summary: Around 10,000 writers, featuring authors of bestsellers like 'The Thursday Murder Club' and 'Slow Horses', released an empty book to oppose AI exploitation of their works. The protest targets AI companies' unauthorized use of books for training data. It coincides with discussions on UK AI policy revisions.

items.title: Top 40 US BookTok Creators and Influencers Driving Book Trends in 2026
items.summary: BookTok influencers continue to boost sales dramatically, with older titles seeing up to 1,698% increases after going viral. The list highlights key creators shaping reading trends. Publishers increasingly leverage these platforms for discovery and promotion.

items.title: New York Times' Notable Book Releases for March 2026
items.summary: The New York Times selects 27 new releases, featuring big names like Ibram X. Kendi and a Judy Blume biography. Highlights include diverse fiction and nonfiction titles. These picks signal major anticipated reads for the month.

items.title: Sarah Ferguson Snubbed for £1.5million Book Deal Over Epstein Scandal
items.summary: Sarah Ferguson has been denied a major US book deal worth £1.5 million due to reluctance to let her profit from Epstein connections. Publishers fear backlash from the scandal. This marks a setback in her post-royal publishing pursuits.

items.title: Rachel Zegler Addresses Backlash to Disney's Snow White Remake
items.summary: Rachel Zegler spoke out about the backlash she received for her casting as Snow White in Disney's live-action remake, citing confusion over criticisms related to her Colombian-Polish heritage and threats to her safety. The film underwent a politically correct revamp that drew audience criticism, contributing to its status as a box office disappointment and a contender for Razzie awards. Zegler stated she refuses to assimilate for anybody else's comfort.

items.title: Disney's Snow White Live-Action Remake Flops at Box Office Amid Controversy
items.summary: Disney's live-action Snow White starring Rachel Zegler bombed at the box office, with reports indicating significant financial losses and low audience turnout. The remake faced backlash for its woke overhaul, changes to the original story, and casting choices. Production issues, including a canceled premiere and disputes between stars, further fueled negative reception.

items.title: Warner Bros.' The Bride! Bombs at Box Office in Major Flop
items.summary: Maggie Gyllenhaal's The Bride!, featuring Christian Bale and Jessie Buckley, earned just $7.26 million in its opening weekend against a high budget, marking it as Warner Bros.' biggest disaster of 2026. The film, a feminist reinterpretation of the Bride of Frankenstein, received criticism for its heavy-handed messaging on consent and male oppression, leading to poor reviews and audience rejection. It was outperformed by family-friendly Hoppers and Scream 7.

items.title: Alexander Brothers Found Guilty in Sex Trafficking Trial
items.summary: Influencer brothers Alex and Alec Sturgo, known as the Alexander Brothers, were convicted by a New York jury of sex trafficking charges. The trial highlighted allegations involving coercion and exploitation within their social circle. The verdict marks a significant moment in pop culture accountability for influencers.

items.title: Tilly Norwood Releases Music Video Addressing AI Backlash
items.summary: AI-generated actor Tilly Norwood released a new music video responding to public backlash against AI in entertainment. The video addresses criticisms of AI performers displacing human actors. It highlights ongoing debates in Hollywood over technology's role in pop culture.

items.title: Leslie Odom Jr. Set for West End Debut in Hamilton
items.summary: Leslie Odom Jr. will reprise his Tony-winning role as Aaron Burr in Hamilton's West End production. The announcement marks a major return for the original cast member to the stage. It underscores Hamilton's continued global popularity in theater.

items.title: Intuit Sees $90M Gain From AI, Plans Physical Stores in 2026
items.summary: Intuit's AI investments since 2019 have delivered nearly $90 million in annualized efficiencies in early 2025 through task automation and better customer matching with tax pros. The company is expanding AI capabilities like Intuit Assist while opening 600 offices and 20 TurboTax stores in 2026 to blend AI with human expertise. This strategy targets small businesses and self-employed users for streamlined tax filing and financial management.

items.title: How to make your e-commerce product visible to AI agents? Use this new system
items.summary: Azoma launched the Agentic Merchant Protocol (AMP), a framework for e-commerce retailers to centralize product data and distribute it to AI-optimized platforms, eliminating manual listings on sites like Amazon. Trusted by brands like L’Oréal and Unilever, it offers control, compliance, and visibility in AI-driven shopping. Small e-commerce businesses can use it to improve discoverability and revenue in the rising agentic commerce era.

items.title: NetRanks Introduces First Platform to Close the Loop Between AI Visibility and Real Marketing Impact
items.summary: NetRanks updated its platform to track 'AI Share-of-Voice,' measuring how often brands appear in AI responses from ChatGPT and Claude, and analyzes why for optimization suggestions. Businesses can adjust messaging and docs to boost mentions without changing AI models. This is crucial for small businesses as AI influences customer choices in recommendations and comparisons.
